title.zh: 在山区省Pinukpuk市镇设立职业学校，名称为Pinukpuk职业学校，并授权为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act to Establish a Vocational School in the Municipality of Pinukpuk, Mountain Province, to be Known as Pinukpuk Vocational School, and to Authorize the Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act to Establish a Vocational School in the Municipality of Pinukpuk, Mountain Province, to be Known as Pinukpuk Vocational School, and to Authorize the Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường Dạy nghề tại Đô thị Pinukpuk, Tỉnh Mountain Province với tên gọi Trường Dạy nghề Pinukpuk, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนอาชีวศึกษา ในเทศบาล Pinukpuk จังหวัด Mountain Province ในชื่อ โรงเรียนอาชีวศึกษา Pinukpuk และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk Sekolah Kejuruan di Kotamadya Pinukpuk, Provinsi Mountain Province dengan nama Sekolah Kejuruan Pinukpuk, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Vokasional di Perbandaran Pinukpuk, Wilayah Mountain Province dengan nama Sekolah Vokasional Pinukpuk, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1965/ra_4429_1965.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There shall be established, under the direct supervision of the Director of Vocational Education, a vocational school in the Municipality of Pinukpuk, Mountain Province, to be known as Pinukpuk Vocational School.

Upon the recommendation of the Director of Vocational Education, the President of the Philippines shall set aside and reserve such portion of the public lands located within the Municipality of Pinukpuk, Mountain Province, as may be necessary and convenient for the establishment of the school site.

The sum of one hundred thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the establishment, operation and maintenance of the said school for the fiscal year. Thereafter, the necessary sums for said purpose shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1965.
